gloss: prime working age; peak of one's working life

definitions.gloss: prime of one's working life; peak working years
definitions.explanation: The period when a person is at the peak of their energy and productivity at work, typically one's 30s and 40s.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}りだ。
examples.english: My father is now in his prime working years.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
{働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In my prime working years, I worked overtime late every day.

notes:
Refers to the years when one is most active and capable at work, usually one's 30s and 40s.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧: the prime-working-age generation
- {働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧: a man in his working prime

USAGE:
The suffix {盛|ざか}り means 'peak' or 'height of', also seen in {食|た}べ{盛|ざか}り (a growing child with a big appetite) and {伸|の}び{盛|ざか}り (a growth spurt).
